description: Every Google Business Profile account and location this deployment's operator credential can manage — the picker data for set_gbp_connection. Not project-scoped data (the answer does not depend on the project passed; projectId only satisfies the ownership check). Returns `{ accounts: [{ name, accountName, locations: [...] }] }`. Live Google API calls.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: list_gbp_locations
